answer: The atlas board publishes an atlas line, the pigment stake for admission: 50 credits, rising 1 credit per 10 admissions, so the 1,000th fake pays 150, and 1,000 fakes lock 99,600. A reef record carries the peak line to the next epoch, so waiting cannot reset it. Each stake is key-bound and non-transferable, and one key admits one identity. The ledger is public, so anyone can recompute the line and reject an understated stake. A reset-attack ring fails because the reef record holds the line up. An honest user pays the line once plus a 10-credit fee and recovers the stake after one epoch.
